purpose: Anti-rediscovery guardrail: already proved finite claims, closest primary prior art, stopped product ideas, invalid model transfers, superseded formulations and deferred broad claims. NOT a global literature completeness claim.

policy.CLOSED_PROVED: Do not rerun same mathematical target unless independent validation or formalization changes.
policy.PRIOR_ART: Do not re-propose as novel under same assumptions; source/definition match still required.
policy.STOP_PRODUCT: Do not implement standalone Rust product from this claim without a demonstrated new end-to-end operation and benefit.
policy.SUPERSEDED: Historical statement remains citation/provenance only; the stronger record governs.
policy.MODEL_MISMATCH: Never transfer conclusion without explicit model-preserving reduction.
policy.DEFER: Not selected: missing cost/model or known adjacent work; not proof of impossibility.

entries.title: UCT finite-state reachable-observation Hamming-ball bound
entries.scope: Exact state observation O on graph G; code phi into GF(q)^m with <=w changed coordinates per transition implies N_O(x,d)<=V_q(m,min(dw,m)).
entries.do_not_repeat: Elementary triangle-inequality and reachable Hamming-ball counting; generalizes presentation of KR-001 but does not add cell-probe/query/communication lower bounds or new scientific novelty.
entries.reopen_only_if: A stronger graph-structural or joint priced-resource theorem not implied by reachability volumes, after explicit prior-art model transfer.

entries.title: Binary unit-write locality as classical cubical graph embeddability
entries.scope: For O=id,q=2,w=1, injective encoding of undirected G is graph embedding as subgraph of hypercube; triangle and bipartite K(2,3) obstruct it.
entries.do_not_repeat: Cubical-graph embeddability and NP-completeness of recognition are known decades before UCT; Hamming-ball capacity is necessary not sufficient and does not establish a new characterization.
entries.reopen_only_if: A proven strictly distinct observation congruence plus fully charged update/query constraints beyond classical cubical or partial-cube models.

entries.title: Ko 2026 Multiphase Boolean cell-probe joint update-query bound
entries.scope: Source Theorem 1.1 claims Omega((log n/log(t_u w))^2) query total when m=n^(1+Omega(1)), t_u=n^o(1), inner product over GF(2); author proof NOT independently reverified.
entries.do_not_repeat: Do not claim coupling update/query cell-probe complexity or adding a verification round as UCT originality; Ko's 2.5-round communication lower-bound device is not a Merkle/authenticated witness.
entries.reopen_only_if: Independently verify exact primary proof and exhibit a theorem in an explicit new resource model not reducible to Ko/Fredman-Saks/Patrascu-Demaine.

entries.title: Any fixed finite absent-q-gram budget has arbitrarily weak source-only COPY/ADD floor
entries.scope: For each fixed r>=1, B=(ab)^r b^(2m) (ab)^r and T=(ab)^m have all U_q=0 up to 2r and relaxed floor 2, while K*>=4m/(2r+1) in the frozen toy fixed-charge model.
entries.do_not_repeat: Exact derived-classical adversarial family; no uniform tightness from any fixed finite qmax of absent-window counts. Do not misstate as real VCDIFF bytes or impossibility for growing q or richer indices.
entries.reopen_only_if: A structural or growing-scale certificate with honestly charged preprocessing, new tightness theorem and source-specific prior-art comparison.

entries.title: Deterministic adaptive query influence implies read-write transversal
entries.scope: For exact deterministic bit-probe queries over a charged code, changed observable answers on edge (x,y) imply a changed code cell on each old-state adaptive read path; write support has size at least the read-path transversal number.
entries.do_not_repeat: Elementary indistinguishable-transcript and hitting-set lemma. Not a new cryptographic soundness theorem or an original general cell-probe lower bound.
entries.reopen_only_if: A stronger quantified multi-probe update/proof bound in a fully charged natural task that surpasses Fredman-Saks and other same-model source results.

entries.title: Exact single-bit-probe Boolean read-write frontier for prefix parity
entries.scope: For c distinct nonconstant Boolean query functions modulo complement, exact one-bit probe needs at least c stored cells and each update rewrites >=changed function classes; for n prefix XOR queries, m>=n,w>=n, both sharp.
entries.do_not_repeat: Elementary one-probe representation-class argument; does not imply a new p>=2 lower bound, signed certificate theorem or universal w*p>=n; Fenwick refutes the last claim.
entries.reopen_only_if: Prove a nontrivial same-model multi-probe plus sound-annotation frontier beyond classical partial sums bounds with finite adversarial oracle and construction.

entries.title: Unit-write rigidity of complete hypercube encodings and deterministic query depth
entries.scope: Any injective exact binary encoding of all n-bit coordinate-toggle states with at most one changed memory coordinate per toggle is a fixed coordinate injection plus offset; bit-query depth at least original decision-tree depth; for full prefix parity p>=n.
entries.do_not_repeat: Classical full-hypercube graph embedding rigidity. Do not claim that every local-write code is systematic or that p>=n when w>1; Fenwick avoids the one-write assumption.
entries.reopen_only_if: A verified nontrivial upper/lower multi-probe joint tradeoff with fully charged history and sound proofs that is not a special case of published dynamic partial sums bounds.

entries.title: Private-coin sound-witness read/update support packing with sharp unit-write parity bound
entries.scope: In a deterministic stored bit representation with private verifier coins, completeness at least one minus alpha for a fixed honest witness and soundness at most delta for every false claim and witness, every sensitive update support is hit with probability at least one minus alpha minus delta. Weighted fractional support packing gives a data probe lower bound; when full n-bit toggle representation has write-locality one, parity requires at least n times one minus alpha minus delta reads. A sample-p-data-bits with n-bit witness protocol is sharp for zero completeness error.
entries.do_not_repeat: Combines classical coupling, fractional certificate and adversary packing, cubical embedding and random sampling. NOT a new information-theoretic impossibility for charged online MA, not a claim of cryptographic soundness, not a lower bound on p when w is two or a hash cache exists.
entries.reopen_only_if: An original fully priced dynamic state plus proof-bits plus verifier-work plus access theorem strictly separating from the 2007 bit-probe, 2021 fractional adversary and online annotated stream literature.

entries.title: Fractional block sensitivity and randomized certificate adversary are established prior art
entries.scope: Randomized certificate complexity and fractional block sensitivity are classical query complexity measures. The 2021 ACM TOCT theorem states equivalence of known classical adversary methods for total Boolean functions, while Ben-David and Kothari 2026 construct randomized query complexity below deterministic certificate complexity.
entries.do_not_repeat: Do not relabel an ordinary fractional hitting-set LP as a new general lower bound and do not transfer deterministic certificate complexity directly to bounded-error randomized decision trees. The 2026 statement is source-abstract level and full proof was not independently audited.
entries.reopen_only_if: A quantifiably nonredundant theorem with paid online updates, untrusted proof generation, authenticated persistent state, and matched old/new adversarial transcript assumptions.

entries.title: Linear local parity proof rank forces sharp witness length versus bit probes
entries.scope: For unit-write injective n-bit toggle representations and one exact full-parity claimed answer, a one-check private-coin verifier testing GF(2) parity on at most p stored bits with perfect completeness and soundness strictly below one must receive at least ceil(n/p) minus one untrusted witness bits. A block-parity prover with ceil(n/p) groups reaches equality in witness length and has soundness error one minus reciprocal number of groups.
entries.do_not_repeat: Classical affine rank and witness-cover proof, not a theorem for arbitrary nonlinear adaptive verification, cryptographic succinct proofs, zero-knowledge, word probes or completely priced online authentication. The witness verifier reads the message and does local work that are outside p.
entries.reopen_only_if: A genuinely new same-model nonlinear or end-to-end dynamic transcript lower bound with quantified proof generation, state maintenance and verifier work, strictly beyond annotated streams and PCP of proximity prior art.

entries.title: Nonlinear p-local sound witness fibers need not obey affine GF2 rank cap
entries.scope: For n=4 input bits and p=3, one nonadaptive nonlinear local verifier witness with perfect completeness can certify the six even strings of Hamming weight two; the GF(2) affine parity-check rank fiber bound for n=4 p=3 would permit at most four states per linear witness. A complete one-bit-witness protocol has soundness three quarters for both claimed parity labels.
entries.do_not_repeat: Do not apply the linear rank fiber argument from G2-5 to arbitrary nonlinear/adaptive witnesses. This finite counterexample does not refute the global witness length inequality or establish an asymptotic lower bound.
entries.reopen_only_if: A separate nonlinear/adaptive proof with new structural invariant or a finite counterexample to the actual general b versus p inequality, with soundness quantified over all malicious witnesses.
